title: Random Adjective Generator - Pick an English Adjective
meta_description: Generate one random English adjective for writing, vocabulary practice, naming exercises, or games.
intro: Generate up to ten adjectives or neutral adjective-and-noun combinations.

sections.h2: How do I generate a random adjective?
sections.content: Click Generate for one adjective, then copy the result or generate another.

sections.h2: How can a random adjective help with writing?
sections.content: Pair the result with a noun to create an unexpected phrase, character trait, setting detail, or short writing constraint.

sections.h2: What does this tool not check?
sections.content: The tool does not check grammar, tone, reading level, or whether the adjective fits your sentence. Review the result in context.

faq.question: Does it include comparative adjectives?
faq.answer: The current list mainly contains base-form adjectives.

faq.question: Can I add my own adjectives?
faq.answer: No. To randomize your own vocabulary list, use the List Randomizer.

faq.question: Can the same word appear again?
faq.answer: Yes. Each click makes an independent selection, so repeats are possible.
